checks.name: typescript-circular-dependencies
checks.comment: Both frontends are Vue: their graphs are the Vue-aware ones below (typescript-circular-dependencies-{portal,admin}), which pass --ts-config and the vue extension. This checker only parses ts/tsx, and a .ts file using import.meta (each app's entry) fails its parser, so the Vue apps belong to the other graphs. This graph also passes a ts-config so the TypeScript sources are parsed as TypeScript.

checks.name: pip-audit-api
command: uv export --locked --project {root}/apps/api --format requirements-txt --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-emit-local --no-header --output-file /tmp/soymutdb-api-audit-requirements.txt && uvx --from pip-audit==2.9.0 pip-audit --cache-dir /tmp/soymutdb-pip-audit-cache --strict --no-deps --disable-pip --format json --output {output_dir}/pip-audit-api.json --requirement /tmp/soymutdb-api-audit-requirements.txt
checks.mutating_command: uv export --locked --project {root}/apps/api --format requirements-txt --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-emit-local --no-header --output-file /tmp/soymutdb-api-audit-requirements.txt && uvx --from pip-audit==2.9.0 pip-audit --cache-dir /tmp/soymutdb-pip-audit-cache --strict --no-deps --disable-pip --format json --output {output_dir}/pip-audit-api.json --requirement /tmp/soymutdb-api-audit-requirements.txt
checks.normalize_recipe_note: pip-audit writes the normalized requirement file back as its `--fix` pass. With `--disable-pip --no-deps` it does not, so the normalized file this check names is produced here from the exported pins instead.
